home.heroTitle: Learn to build with WordPress, web and AI
home.heroSubtitle: Hands-on bootcamps from WPBrigade. Finish one and you earn a certificate anyone can verify — no phone calls, no waiting on us to confirm it.
home.feature1Desc: WPBrigade has built WordPress products and client work for years. The bootcamps teach what we actually do, not theory.
home.feature2Desc: Every certificate is cryptographically signed. An employer can confirm it's genuine in seconds, from the certificate alone.
home.feature3Desc: Add it to your LinkedIn profile in two clicks, download it, or send the link. It stays valid whether or not you stay in touch with us.
home.section1Feature1: WordPress development — themes, plugins, and the APIs behind them
home.section1Feature2: Web development fundamentals for people starting out
home.section1Feature3: AI bootcamps for building with today's tools
home.section1Feature4: SEO fundamentals for developers and marketers
home.section2Header: What you get at the end
home.section2Feature1: A certificate naming you, the programme and the dates you attended
home.section2Feature2: A permanent link you can put on a CV or a LinkedIn profile
home.section2Feature3: A QR code that takes anyone straight to the verification page
home.section3Feature1: Scan the QR code, or paste the certificate ID into the verify page
home.section3Feature2: The check is cryptographic — a forged or altered certificate fails it
home.section3Feature3: Built on Open Badges 3.0, so other verification tools can read it too
home.ctaSubtitle: Talk to us about which programme fits, or verify a certificate you've been sent.
home.recipientSubtitle: Your certificate was emailed to you when it was issued, and your account uses that same address.

about.title: About WPBrigade bootcamps
about.subtitle: Who runs these programmes, and why the certificates work the way they do
about.missionBody: WPBrigade has spent years building WordPress products and client work. The bootcamps pass that on — practical training in the things we do daily, run in cohorts and taught by people doing the work.
about.credentialsBody: A certificate is only worth what it can prove. Ours are cryptographically signed and follow Open Badges 3.0, an open standard, so anyone can confirm one is genuine without contacting us — and nobody can forge or quietly alter one.

getStarted.title: Getting started
getStarted.subtitle: How the bootcamps and the certificates work
getStarted.step1Body: Get in touch to find out which bootcamp fits and when the next cohort starts.
getStarted.step2Body: Each programme has criteria to meet. They're listed on the certificate itself, so anyone reading it knows what it took.
getStarted.step3Body: It arrives by email when you finish, with a link to view, download and share it. Your account is created at the same time, using the same address.
